description: publish_protocol_surface ignores all non-Function forms, so a defimpl co-located with defprotocol in the same file is never registered. Extend protocol indexing/publication so co-located root-level defimpls register their Protocol.Target sources (via T1's mechanism). This is what lets 'reference the protocol' make its built-in impls demandable. Signal: defining a protocol makes Protocol.<builtin> demandable without naming the type module. Depends on T1.
title: Protocol publication registers co-located root-level defimpl sources
